## Welcome to Advanced Water Technologies

At Advanced Water Technologies Limited, we realise that what we do probably isn’t the most exciting.
But we recognise that what we do is essential. As thanks to our reliable, cost effective and
compliant **water treatment services** we are able to control bacteria and effectively save people’s
lives.

[Water Treatment Services][46]

### Why Advanced Water Technologies?

We have over 200 years of practical experience, comprehensive industry accreditations and a vast
knowledge of **water treatment** products and services. This means we can provide a comprehensive
range of **water treatment** programmes designed to meet customer’s exact needs and conforming to
the latest legislation requirements.

We have locations in the North West, East Midlands and the South East delivering flexible water
treatment products and services nationally throughout the UK. Covering a range of industrial and
commercial sectors, we consistently deliver quality water treatment solutions that are financially,
technically and environmentally sustainable.

### Why are we different?

What makes Advanced Water Technologies different is our people – experts in what we do and
passionate about developing long lasting and trusted customer relationships – our staff are
regularly trained and competency checked to ensure we deliver the best water treatments possible.
Click here to find out more [about our team][47].

And our customers are pretty special and important to us too. To ensure that we continue to operate
at the highest levels of customer service and technical know-how, we undertake an independent
evaluation every year.

At Advanced Water Technologies Limited, we realise that what we do probably isn’t the most exciting.

treatment products and services nationally throughout the UK. Covering a range of industrial and
commercial sectors, we consistently deliver quality water treatment solutions that are financially,
technically and environmentally sustainable.

# **METALWORKING FLUID SPECIALIST**

Asia Talenta Mandiri, berlokasi di BSD (Bumi Serpong Damai, Tangerang) dan Cikarang dikenal sebagai
perusahaan *metal working fluids specialist*, distributor untuk berbagai jenis pelumas
(*lubricants*) dan distributor gemuk pelumas di Indonesia, terutama untuk industri pembuatan metal
atau logam yakni berbasis minyak (*oil base*) atau air (*water base*). Cairan ini dibutuhkan saat
proses pembentukan logam, yang berfungsi untuk menurunkan suhu panas atau sebagai pelumas.

## PT. Asia Talenta Mandiri

Metalworking chemicals, cairan kimia yang dibutuhkan untuk proses pembentukan logam sesuai dengan
peruntukannya dibagi atas beberapa bagian. Dimulai dari Grease, Rust Preventive Oil, Cutting and
Grinding, Maintenance Oil, Heat Treatment Oil dan Press Punching. 

Our product:

Grease – Rust Preventive Oil – Cutting & Grinding – Maintenance Oil – Heat Treatment Oil – Press and
Punching

## What we do.

Calvary Industries formulates and produces blended process chemicals such as industrial cleaners,
conversion coatings, metalworking fluids, and waste treatment chemistries. We also blend, package
and otherwise process customer-owned product to customer specifications. Material is shipped in
containers ranging from one gallon to bulk tank trucks. With manufacturing capabilities throughout
North America and partner’s abroad, our geographical service area is extensive.

## Who we are.

We are a group of professionals who realize that customers drive our business. You’ll notice this
attitude in the prompt, personal answer of your phone call, the technical advice from a chemist, or
the quick and informed response from your sales or customer service representative.

**Applications:**   Short term protection to long term indoor storage of any sized part of
work-piece

#### "CGF was the only company willing to invest the time and resources to develop a  custom
#### lubricant for our Prism machining centers. They solved our issues, and we have been using their

####  - Product Evaluation Group
####     CATERPILLAR 



45+ Years of Experience   

 300+ Products



For over forty years, CGF, Inc. has distinguished itself by formulating and manufacturing high
performance industrial fluids for top names in the industry. Boeing, Caterpillar, Cessna, John Deer,
Komatsu, and others have come to rely on our fluid solutions to maximize their production
capabilities and maintain their competitive advantage.



Take the next step and [contact us][38] to learn how we can take your business to the next level of
performance and productivity.





CGF (Cutting & Grinding Fluids, Inc.) is an ISO 9001 Certified company with

DNV CERT-04341-2005-AQ-HOU-ANAB. CGF also carries a quality assurance

certificate with Bombardier, Lear Jet Division (BAMS 569-001, Class A, Rev. B).

### METALWORKING COOLANTS


**Product Range:** Water miscible micro emulsion chemistries to straight oil formulations

**Applications:**   High performance CNC machining to flute and gear grinding 

### INDUSTRIAL LUBRICANTS


**Product Range:** Fully formulated lubricants incorporating Group II Base Stocks and world class
additive packages

**Applications:** High speed spindles and turbines to vertical way systems

### CLEANERS & DEGREASERS


**Product Range:** True solution, micro emulsion, and solvent-based cleaners and degreasers

**Applications:** Vibratory cleaning to high-volume cabinet washers

### RUST PREVENTATIVES


**Product Range:** Low VOC/No VOC water based formulations to more traditional straight oil 

and solvent cut-back blends

**Applications:**   Short term protection to long term indoor storage of any sized part of
work-piece

Η COOLIVE είναι επίσημος διανομέας των λιπαντικών MOL Ουγγαρίας. H εταιρεία, πρωταγωνιστεί

### Γιατί ξεχωρίζουμε ?

είμαστε σε θέση να δημιουργήσουμε ανταλλακτικά κατά παραγγελία

Αποκλειστικό service μηχανημάτων και ανταλλακτικά για εκπυρηνωτικές μηχανές ελιάς
Με σεβασμό στον πελάτη μας και όπλο την εξειδίκευση μας στοχεύουμε στην ταχύτερη δυνατή εξυπηρέτηση
σας. Αναλαμβάνουμε εγκαταστάσεις - επισκευές - ανακατασκευές - βελτιώσεις του βιομηχανικού
εξοπλισμού σας.
Coolive tailor made spare parts

Μπορούμε να παρέχουμε άμεσα τεχνικές λύσεις σε ανταλλακτικά και αναλώσιμα. Κατασκευάζουμε για εσάς
καινοτόμα προϊόντα και λύσεις υψηλών προδιαγραφών βασισμένα στις πιο σύγχρονες μεθόδους ψηφιακής
σχεδίασης και παραγωγής.

Χρησιμοποιούμε υλικά και μεθόδους κατεργασίας δοκιμασμένα στις πιο αντίξοες βιομηχανικές συνθήκες.
Στόχος μας είναι να εφαρμόσουμε εξατομικευμένες επιλογές και υπηρεσίες που αυξάνουν την δυναμικότητα
και μειώνουν το κοστος παραγωγής σας.

Coolive made λύσεις
Η Coolive αντιμετωπίζει με ταπεινότητα και προσήλωση τις αναγκές στο χώρο της βιομηχανίας. Δέσμευση
μας είναι να βοηθήσουμε τους πελάτες μας να επιτύχουν τους επιχειρησιακούς και επιχειρηματικούς
στόχους τους. Παρέχουμε ένα συνολικό πακέτο που περιλαμβάνει ολοκληρωμένη τεχνική ανάλυση και
υποστήριξη για κάθε βιομηχανική εφαρμογή.
Άμεση τεχνική υποστήριξη - Coolive Service
Διαθέσιμοι 24/7 εξυπηρέτηση πελατών και τεχνική υποστήριξη. Ακριβής και έγκαιρη παράδοση των
παραγγελιών σας.
* Βελτιωμένη απόδοση του βιομηχανικού εξοπλισμού.
* Εξάλειψη των φθορών και βλαβών.
* Μειωμένα κόστη συντήρησης.
* Συνεργασία με τους μεγαλύτερους προμηθευτές παγκοσμίως στην Βιομηχανική ψύξη
  BITZER-GUNTNER-CARRIER-ALFA LAVAL
* Συνεργασία με ENCO OFM στην επεξεργασία ελιάς.
* Συνεργασία με την MOL όσον αφορά τα Βιομηχανικά λιπαντικά.

# Fuels & Lubricants Supplier Since 1947

As a UK leading fuels and lubricants supplier, we believe excellent service before and after your
oil delivery is the key to our success. This, combined with our expert, local knowledge, competitive
fuel prices and reliable deliveries, ensures we’ve remained at the forefront of the oil industry for
over 75 years.

## Fuelling your success since 1947

Our large customer base includes every industry from industrial and data centres to farms, marine,
construction and much more. Our vast, diverse fleet of [HVO-fuelled vehicles][82] and national depot
network enables us to provide 24-48 hour deliveries as standard, plus an urgent emergency delivery
service for time-sensitive scenarios. You can count on us when you need us most.

Whether you’re looking for diesel or heating oils, renewable fuels, lubricants, storage tanks, or
any of our other products and fuel-related services – you can rest easy, safe in the knowledge of
our team and in-house experts.

## Our environmental commitment

Crown Oil was the first UK fuel supplier to switch our entire delivery fleet to HVO fuel, and we are
the first to be [certified carbon neutral by BSI to ISO 14068-1][83] and certified to be net zero by
2050 with their Net Zero Pathway. We are now supporting businesses in their journey to net zero too,
with our range of sustainable solutions on hand.

With over 75 years’ experience in the industry, we are committed to providing the best solution to
support your business. That’s why we’ve extended our product portfolio to include a range of
cleaner-burning products to support you in reaching your sustainability goals.

**Research and Development**

The Falcon R&D team is the best in the industry and has over 50 years of experience developing
technology to stay one step ahead of the changing demands of modern manufacturing.   Our Research
and Development team has the ability to custom formulate products for a specific applications and
customer requirements.

We start by evaluating your current process fluid use. This includes the application, desired
benefits and the problems you’re experiencing. We examine foaming, odor, galling, finish, parts
cleaning, tool life, dermatitis, residual film and price. We keep OSHA and EPA rules in mind when
evaluating your application.

Only after reviewing your applications and specific issues, do we start the recommendation process.
We examine our wide array of product formulas to determine which will best meet your needs. Then we
look at adjusting the formulation to better address critical aspects of your application. After this
evaluation and formula review process, we recommend a specific product. That’s why we say Falcon
Industrial provides “Custom solutions, not stock answers.”   In today’s precision
manufacturing environment, off-the-shelve isn’t good enough.

**Technical Support**

Technical support is Falcon Industrial’s hallmark. We’re committed to providing you the highest
level of service. Our objective is to provide solutions. Off-the-shelf isn’t good enough. We seek to
understand your total process so we can recommend a product specifically formulated to achieve the
best results. Our technical staff understands every facet of industrial processes that use
metalworking fluids, lubricants and cleaning chemicals. These include traditional processes such as
coolant systems, coatings, cleaning, and casting operations, as well as hydroforming, minimizing
waste and coolant recycling.

We also provide technical expertise that supports process efficiency improvements such as waste
water treatment and oil reclamation.  Our staff has the necessary skills to meet assist you in
reaching your production goals.

**Research and Development**

The Falcon R&D team is the best in the industry and has over 50 years of experience developing
technology to stay one step ahead of the changing demands of modern manufacturing.   Our Research
and Development team has the ability to custom formulate products for a specific applications and
customer requirements.

We start by evaluating your current process fluid use. This includes the application, desired
benefits and the problems you’re experiencing. We examine foaming, odor, galling, finish, parts
cleaning, tool life, dermatitis, residual film and price. We keep OSHA and EPA rules in mind when
evaluating your application.

Only after reviewing your applications and specific issues, do we start the recommendation process.
We examine our wide array of product formulas to determine which will best meet your needs. Then we
look at adjusting the formulation to better address critical aspects of your application. After this
evaluation and formula review process, we recommend a specific product. That’s why we say Falcon
Industrial provides “Custom solutions, not stock answers.”   In today’s precision
manufacturing environment, off-the-shelve isn’t good enough.

understand your total process so we can recommend a product specifically formulated to achieve the
best results. Our technical staff understands every facet of industrial processes that use
metalworking fluids, lubricants and cleaning chemicals. These include traditional processes such as
coolant systems, coatings, cleaning, and casting operations, as well as hydroforming, minimizing
waste and coolant recycling.

We also provide technical expertise that supports process efficiency improvements such as waste
water treatment and oil reclamation.  Our staff has the necessary skills to meet assist you in

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to

reliability in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and hazardous operations.

## Halocarbon history

Halocarbon is a respected industry leader and trusted partner, offering a comprehensive range of
engineered fluid solutions that cater to diverse applications, from early-stage development to
long-term supply.

fluorochemicals.

At Halocarbon, we strive to build lasting partnerships and leverage our expertise in fluorochemistry
to solve the toughest challenges. And, in the end, we answer to our  clients… not to Wall Street.

# / most advanced metalworking fluids

Hangsterfer’s Laboratories, Inc. specializes in the research, development, custom formulation, and
manufacture of a full-line of REACH compliant metalworking lubricants. This includes emulsifiable
oils, semi-synthetics, synthetics, straight cutting oils, drawing and forming compounds, EDM fluid
and machine lubricants.

*"Our products will exceed your expectations without compromise to health, safety or environmental
concerns."*

As a result of its long-term research and development, Hangsterfer's offers a wide range of products
for the entire process chain of metalworking.


Moreover, Hangsterfer's develops and produces individually tailored product concepts in cooperation
with well-known machine tool manufacturers for the automotive and automotive supply industry as well
as the aerospace industry and medical technology. Our focus is on the entire process chain in order
to open new technologies, synergy effects and saving potentials to our customers.

 

We pool our strengths to be successful - our young team takes its knowledge from practice for
practice and combines it with theoretical lubricant studies and field ready processes. With this
extrem high level of knowledge Hangsterfer's is the first choice for turnarounds and new beginnings
in metalworking companies. Become the best reference and start using our problem-free and
ultra-stable metalworking lubricants.

 


# / our products

Hangsterfer's is not only providing innovative high performance products but is also supporting the
customer by offering competent application advice and broad lab services. Hangsterfer's has
established a tight network sales partners and specialists in all important industrial markets in
and outside Europe to guarantee a high standard of service and consultation on an international
level.

 

Hangsterfer's first class in quality and perfomance for your processes!

 

The full range of Hangsterfer's metalworking lubricants covers water soluble and neat oils as well
as high-performance cleaners:

 

Water-soluble metalworking fluids:
Building on our legacy of ultra-reliable coolants like S-500CF, our 700 Series Bio-Hard ® technology
has evolved from the high quality emulsifiable oils (high oil content) into semi-synthetic (low oil
content) and full synthetics (no oil content). Hangsterfer’s only uses highly refined, ultra -pure
ingredients. All of Hangsterfer’s coolant concentrates are formulated with advanced technologies,
which utilize synthetic, vegetable and petroleum components.


Non-water-miscible metalworking fluids (neat/straight oils):
Hangsterfer’s cutting oils are recognized by Swiss-Style screw machine manufacturers around the
world. Hard-Cut ® has improved tool life and surface qualities by as much as 300%. In addition to
the lubricity provided at the cutting zone, our cutting oils provide excellent lubrication for the
machine’s slides, guide bushings, bearings, and spindles. Hangsterfer’s Next Generation® (NG) Series
is formulated with the industry’s safest chlorinated extreme pressure additives, and our Missile
Lube ® series is both chlorine and sulfur free.

 

Metalforming compounds:

Our “grease-like” metalforming compounds are highly fortified with additives that prevent
metal-to-metal contact at the tool-workpiece interface where temperatures can exceed 1000° C. We
specialize in forming and drawing compounds for tube, rod, wire, bar and blanks. Hangsterfer’s can
custom blend products for whatever unique metalforming application you may have.

 

Machine Lubricants

 

In the early 1980s, Hangsterfer’s developed “coolant compatible” machine lubricants that do not
cause negative coolant effects such as odor, staining and dermatitis. Our unique “coolant
compatible” formulations allows the oil to remain on the sliding surface in a completely fluid-like
state, thus protecting the surface more effectively than old technology. Water is repelled which
improves lubrication and prevents corrosion.

 

Our products are used in a variety of industries all over Europe. In close cooperation with our
customers, we develop and produce in accordance with strict quality levels and go far beyond the
standards in regard to ecology and health. Be well prepared for anything and do not left your
success to chance. Chose Hangsterfer's - chose the top of the line. We will find the right coolant
for your process.

The full range of Hangsterfer's metalworking lubricants covers water soluble and neat oils as well

Water-soluble metalworking fluids:
Building on our legacy of ultra-reliable coolants like S-500CF, our 700 Series Bio-Hard ® technology
has evolved from the high quality emulsifiable oils (high oil content) into semi-synthetic (low oil
content) and full synthetics (no oil content). Hangsterfer’s only uses highly refined, ultra -pure
ingredients. All of Hangsterfer’s coolant concentrates are formulated with advanced technologies,
which utilize synthetic, vegetable and petroleum components.


Non-water-miscible metalworking fluids (neat/straight oils):
Hangsterfer’s cutting oils are recognized by Swiss-Style screw machine manufacturers around the
world. Hard-Cut ® has improved tool life and surface qualities by as much as 300%. In addition to
the lubricity provided at the cutting zone, our cutting oils provide excellent lubrication for the
machine’s slides, guide bushings, bearings, and spindles. Hangsterfer’s Next Generation® (NG) Series
is formulated with the industry’s safest chlorinated extreme pressure additives, and our Missile
Lube ® series is both chlorine and sulfur free.

 

Metalforming compounds:

Our “grease-like” metalforming compounds are highly fortified with additives that prevent
metal-to-metal contact at the tool-workpiece interface where temperatures can exceed 1000° C. We
specialize in forming and drawing compounds for tube, rod, wire, bar and blanks. Hangsterfer’s can
custom blend products for whatever unique metalforming application you may have.

 

Machine Lubricants

 

In the early 1980s, Hangsterfer’s developed “coolant compatible” machine lubricants that do not
cause negative coolant effects such as odor, staining and dermatitis. Our unique “coolant
compatible” formulations allows the oil to remain on the sliding surface in a completely fluid-like
state, thus protecting the surface more effectively than old technology. Water is repelled which
improves lubrication and prevents corrosion.

 

Our products are used in a variety of industries all over Europe. In close cooperation with our
customers, we develop and produce in accordance with strict quality levels and go far beyond the
standards in regard to ecology and health. Be well prepared for anything and do not left your
success to chance. Chose Hangsterfer's - chose the top of the line. We will find the right coolant
for your process.

# Jokisch - 60 jahre jung

Mit über 60 Jahren Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Herstellung von Kühlschmierstoffen,
Metallbearbeitungsölen und Reinigungsmitteln bieten wir innovative deutsche Spitzentechnologie und
individuellen, kundenorientierten Service.

Wir stellen uns den Herausforderungen unserer Kunden mit unserem Markenversprechen: **GENIAL.
EINFACH. REIBUNGSLOS.**

 

Unsere Produkte sind das Ergebnis jahrzehntelanger Forschung und Entwicklung.
Die Leistungsmerkmale unserer Produkte finden sich in den Produktnamen wieder.
Dadurch erhalten Sie als Anwender wichtige Informationen bereits durch die Bezeichnung der Produkte
und können somit EINFACH die für Sie richtige Auswahl treffen.

### Unser Leistungsspektrum

### Kühlschmierstoffe

Das Element Wasser steht für die Dynamik bei den wassermischbaren Kühlschmierstoffen. Stetige
Änderungen der Gesetze erwarten von uns als Hersteller eine hohe Flexibilität - so wie sich Wasser
auch immer seinen Weg bahnt. Deswegen werden die Produktnamen durch Flüsse symbolisiert. [zu den
Produkten ][96]

### Metallbearbeitungsöle

Für was steht das Element Erde Bodenständigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit. Ein Spiegelbild der
Metallbearbeitungsöle. Sie werden schon wesentlich länger für die Metallbearbeitung verwendet und
die Grundlage wurde wenig aber stetig verändert. Diese Entwicklung spiegeln Berge als Produktnamen
perfekt wieder.[zu den Produkten ][97]

Metallbearbeitungsölen und Reinigungsmitteln bieten wir innovative deutsche Spitzentechnologie und
individuellen, kundenorientierten Service.

Wir stellen uns den Herausforderungen unserer Kunden mit unserem Markenversprechen: **GENIAL.
EINFACH. REIBUNGSLOS.**

 

Unsere Produkte sind das Ergebnis jahrzehntelanger Forschung und Entwicklung.

und können somit EINFACH die für Sie richtige Auswahl treffen.

auch immer seinen Weg bahnt. Deswegen werden die Produktnamen durch Flüsse symbolisiert. [zu den

#### industrial needs. From general purpose, wet or dry film, chain and cable or MQL, we have a
#### product that will deliver on results and minimize costly downtime.

## Corrosion Inhibitors

#### When corrosion and rust are a concern, you can trust LPS® and Rustlick™ products to protect
#### your work. Check out our range of moisture absorbing, displacing and protective coatings and
#### see why investment in prevention saves time and money in the long run.

[SEE PRODUCTS][146]

## Cleaners

#### In addition to SCRUBS in-a-Bucket® Hand Cleaner Towels, we offer a variety of other targeted
#### application cleaners for virtually any industrial cleaning need. From degreasing to electrical
#### cleaners to disinfectants, our products are developed for professionals to deliver quick
#### results that keep operations clean, maintained and running.

[SEE PRODUCTS][147]

## Marking

#### Almost 100 years ago, DYKEM® STEEL BLUE® set the industry standard for layout fluids and we’ve
#### grown to provide a full line of specialty industrial marking products. Whether you need a
#### permanent, removable, high temp, high purity mark or a paste that indicates torque or
#### tampering, depend on DYKEM® to deliver.

[SEE PRODUCTS][148]

## Mold Release

#### Our Diamondkote™ and Crystal mold releases offer innovative formulations and customized
#### solutions. The specific chemistry within our products provide unsurpassed performance for
#### rubber, composite, urethane and plastic molding applications bringing increased efficiency and
#### overall quality to operations.

## Lubricants

#### Our LPS®, Rustlick™ and Accu-lube® brands offer lubrication products for the most demanding
#### industrial needs. From general purpose, wet or dry film, chain and cable or MQL, we have a
#### product that will deliver on results and minimize costly downtime.

[SEE PRODUCTS][145]

## Corrosion Inhibitors

#### When corrosion and rust are a concern, you can trust LPS® and Rustlick™ products to protect
#### your work. Check out our range of moisture absorbing, displacing and protective coatings and
#### see why investment in prevention saves time and money in the long run.

[SEE PRODUCTS][146]

## Cleaners

#### In addition to SCRUBS in-a-Bucket® Hand Cleaner Towels, we offer a variety of other targeted
#### application cleaners for virtually any industrial cleaning need. From degreasing to electrical
#### cleaners to disinfectants, our products are developed for professionals to deliver quick
#### results that keep operations clean, maintained and running.

[SEE PRODUCTS][147]

## Marking

#### Almost 100 years ago, DYKEM® STEEL BLUE® set the industry standard for layout fluids and we’ve
#### grown to provide a full line of specialty industrial marking products. Whether you need a
#### permanent, removable, high temp, high purity mark or a paste that indicates torque or
#### tampering, depend on DYKEM® to deliver.

[SEE PRODUCTS][148]

## Mold Release

#### Our Diamondkote™ and Crystal mold releases offer innovative formulations and customized
#### solutions. The specific chemistry within our products provide unsurpassed performance for
#### rubber, composite, urethane and plastic molding applications bringing increased efficiency and
#### overall quality to operations.

# Llano Laptop Cooler

**Advanced Cooling for Gaming and Productivity**

[Shop by catalog][12]

## Llano Laptop Cooler for Gaming Laptops

llano laptop coolers are designed and produced by Shenzhen Lvjuneng Technology Development Co., Ltd.
a hardware manufacturer focused exclusively on laptop thermal management. Every llano cooler is
built around one goal: give your laptop the airflow it needs to perform without throttling,
overheating, or unexpected shutdowns.

The llano product line includes the V10, V12, V12 Ultra, and V13 models, covering laptops from 13
inches up to 21 inches. Each model uses a single large-diameter turbofan a different approach from
the multi-small-fan designs common on the market. This design concentrates airflow directly into the
laptop’s intake vents, producing faster and more consistent heat dissipation.

This is the official llano website, where you can find accurate product information, compare models,
and order directly from the brand.


## llano Laptop Cooler Lineup

##### Llano V10 Series

Compact option with a 4.72-inch fan, ideal for 13-17.3 inch laptops requiring fast cooling.

##### Llano V12 Series

Designed for high-end gaming, features a 5.5-inch turbo fan and adjustable speeds for laptops up to
21 inches.

##### Llano V13 Series

Focuses on quiet operation without RGB, suitable for professional use with 15.6-21 inch devices.

##### Llano Accessories

Includes removable filters and glass mouse pads for enhanced setup efficiency.

## Innovative Approach Tailoring Fluid to Needs

MetalWorking Fluids, LLC is one of the metalworking industry’s leading fluid companies for coolants,
cleaners, and rust preventatives due to our innovative approach that tailors each fluid we formulate
to our customer’s exact needs. No two fluids we make are the same because no two operations are the
same. We work directly with your team to create the most innovative and effective fluid to maximize
profits and streamline processes.
[MetalWorking Fluids Products]

## Our Products

MetalWorking Fluids, LLC has the most diverse lineup of coolants, cleaners, and rust preventatives
to ensure your metalworking operation runs at peak performance. Each fluid is produced to your exact
specifications, overcoming common industry hurdles like corrosion, contamination, and
inefficiencies.

[ Product Lineup ][23]

## Why Us

Our operation is solely run by engineers who understand the complexities of the metalworking
industry. Our specialty extends beyond fluids and encompasses the functionality of machining,
allowing us to create custom coolants, cleaners, and rust preventatives that maximize your
operation.

[ About Us ][24]

## Industries

While MetalWorking Fluids, LLC services a wide variety of industries, we have extensive knowledge in
the drawing and stamping, automotive, aerospace, and metal finishing spaces. We can help improve the
critical machining areas of operation that need precision, heat reduction, corrosion prevention, and
more!

# Ihr Experte & Partner für Kühlschmierstoffe

Willkommen bei der Oemeta Chemische Werke GmbH, einem zertifizierten Familienunternehmen in der
vierten Generation. Seit über 100 Jahren sind wir auf die Entwicklung und Produktion
innovativer [Kühlschmierstoffe][54] (KSS) für die zerspanende Fertigung spezialisiert.

Von Universalschmierstoffen bis hin zu digitalen Lösungen – Oemeta-Produkte stehen für Qualität,
Effektivität, Prozesssicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit. Persönliche Beratung, professionelles
Fluidmanagement und kundenspezifische Lösungen runden unser einzigartiges Angebot ab.

### Welchen Kühlschmierstoff benötigen Sie?

Das richtige Produkt für Ihre Anforderung – das ist unser Anspruch. Über unseren digitalen
KSS-Berater finden Sie schnell und einfach die passende Lösung.

## Kühlschmierstoffe für jeden Anwendungsbedarf

Herausragende Schmierleistung, minimierter Verbrauch und exzellente Verträglichkeit zeichnen unsere
zuverlässigen Kühlschmierstoffe aus. Ob beim Bohren, Schleifen, Fräsen oder Drehen: Oemeta bietet
Spitzenprodukte für jede Anwendung und jedes Bearbeitungsmaterial – egal, ob Metall, Glas oder
Keramik. Entdecken Sie unser großes Angebot an hochwertigen KSS und vielen weiteren Produkten. Z

# Ihr Experte & Partner für Kühlschmierstoffe

Willkommen bei der Oemeta Chemische Werke GmbH, einem zertifizierten Familienunternehmen in der
vierten Generation. Seit über 100 Jahren sind wir auf die Entwicklung und Produktion
innovativer [Kühlschmierstoffe][54] (KSS) für die zerspanende Fertigung spezialisiert.

Von Universalschmierstoffen bis hin zu digitalen Lösungen – Oemeta-Produkte stehen für Qualität,
Effektivität, Prozesssicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit. Persönliche Beratung, professionelles
Fluidmanagement und kundenspezifische Lösungen runden unser einzigartiges Angebot ab.

### Welchen Kühlschmierstoff benötigen Sie?

Das richtige Produkt für Ihre Anforderung – das ist unser Anspruch. Über unseren digitalen
KSS-Berater finden Sie schnell und einfach die passende Lösung.

#### Welcome to Oil UK

Oil UK has been established for over 40 years and enjoys a world-wide reputation for innovation,
product quality and customer service. All of our products are manufactured in the United Kingdom
from the highest quality virgin base stocks and the very latest performance additive technology. We
offer rapid delivery across the UK, Ireland, Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia.

#### Automotive & Commercial

Oil UK products meet or exceed the highest performance standards set by commercial and automotive
engine manufacturers such as Mercedes Benz, BMW, Rolls Royce, Porsche, Volvo, Ford, General Motors
and Volkswagen and oil industry specification bodies such as the American Petroleum Institute (API),
the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) and the European Automobile Manufacturers Association
(ACEA).

#### Industrial

Oil UK specialises in innovative synthetic, semi-synthetic and mineral oil based industrial
lubricants and metalworking fluids. Our substantial product range has been designed to provide
increased performance reduced operating costs and enhanced health and safety.

**Contact us today for superior, World class quality products, excellent customer service and highly
competitive prices**

improvement in safety, employee satisfaction, productivity and corporate responsibility.

## Partner with Sunoco — and power your performance with a brand built to deliver.

Sunoco Lubricants stands for performance, dependability, and a long-standing tradition of fueling
the industries that keep America moving. Built on a legacy trusted by drivers, fleets, technicians,
and industrial professionals for generations, Sunoco lubricants deliver the highest quality
lubricants engineered in the industry to perform in the most demanding applications.

Proven in real-world conditions and built for those who demand more, Sunoco represents reliability,
consistency, and performance you can count on every job, every time.

**When performance matters and reliability is non-negotiable, Sunoco delivers. Let’s build something
strong together.**

## The Sunoco Commitment to Quality and Performance

From passenger vehicles and over-the-road fleets to manufacturing facilities and the most demanding
industrial environments, Sunoco Lubricants delivers high-performance solutions engineered for
protection, consistency, and efficiency wherever the job demands more.

Sunoco provides a comprehensive lubrication portfolio engineered to support automotive, commercial,
and industrial applications with the coverage, flexibility, and performance modern operations
require.

Designed with high-quality base oils and advanced additive technology, every product is built to
meet the evolving demands of modern equipment across a wide range of operating conditions.

**Built to perform under pressure, Sunoco products deliver the protection, longevity, and
reliability professionals depend on every day.**

# A Human Approach to Business Support for the Timber Industry

**Timber Products Manufacturers (TPM) Association provides members with outsourced support for a
budget-friendly flat rate fee.**

MEMBERSHIP

## TPM Association
## A Budget Friendly Solution

By joining TPM’s membership program, companies can gain the assurance that their HR processes are
compliant with all applicable employment laws and regulations, while also benefitting from
comprehensive support for their employee benefit programs, safety services, and human resources.

With access to our full range of services, members can rest assured that their HR department is
running efficiently and effectively with safety in mind.

[Start Your Membership][37]

#### What Membership Means for Your Company
* Assurance of HR process compliance with employment laws and regulations.
* Comprehensive support for employee benefit programs, safety services, and human resources.
* Access to a full range of services to ensure an efficient and effective HR department with safety
  in mind.

## Navigate Complexities & Reduce Uncertainty

HEALTH PLANS

### Comprehensive Health
### Plan Packages

Members are eligible for access to health plan packages. TPM Health Plan benefits can include
medical, dental, vision, short-term disability and life insurance.

An employee assistance program is also available to help navigate everyday challenges.

#### Employment Law
* Employee handbooks
* Education
* Policy reviews
* One-on-one consultations

[Learn More][38]

#### Human Resources
#### Support
* Management training
* Wage surveys
* Regulatory updates
* Human resources audits

[Learn More][39]

#### Safety Services
* On-site safety assessments
* Training – Forklift, CPR & First Aid, LOTO, etc.
* Industrial hygiene services
* Hot work permits

[Learn More][40]

#### Employee Health Plans
* Access a premier national network of physicians and facilities
* Premera Blue Cross for WA, ID, and WY
* Blue Cross Blue Shield of MT for MT
* Cigna for OR
* Delta Dental
* VSP Care for Vision

[Learn More][41]

#### Other TPM Programs
* [Employee Assistance Program (EAP)][42]
* Flexible spending accounts
* Health savings and reimbursement accounts
* [**TPM Scholarship Program**][43]

these areas without the cost of hiring high-ticket consultants and firms.

* All-inclusive support for a flat fee

that is available to you as a member.
